basic_details.job_title: ICSIL Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 20 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Intelligent Communication Systems India (ICSIL) has announced recruitment for 20 Data Entry Operator vacancies on a contract basis. Candidates who are a minimum 12th pass and have computer knowledge of Excel and Tally along with knowledge of accounts can apply for these positions. The notified pay is Rs. 22,411 PM as per minimum wages of GNCT of Delhi. Eligible applicants can submit their online application from 15 October 2026 to 18 October 2026 after depositing the one-time registration fee on the ICSIL website. rows.details: Delhi Consumer Cooperative Wholesale Store Ltd. (DCCWS)
Rs. 22,411/- PM (As per minimum wages of GNCT of Delhi)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the Data Entry Operator position must meet the following essential qualification and age requirements: Essential Qualification: Minimum 12th Pass and having computer knowledge of Excel and Tally and having knowledge of accounts. Age Limit: Up to 40 years.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Data Entry Operators will receive a remuneration of Rs. 22,411/- per month as per the minimum wages of GNCT of Delhi. Fifteen (15) days salary is to be deducted from the selected candidate as security in two parts (50% in the first month and 50% in the second month), which is refundable after receiving a No Dues certificate from the client department and completing contractual liabilities with ICSIL. The engagement is purely on a contractual and outsourced basis for a fixed period or till the expiry of the contract or till regular incumbents join posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICSIL Data Entry Operator
content_sections.text: Go to the official ICSIL website and access the link "How to apply for current Jobs" under the Current Job section in the Career tab. Complete your profile with educational qualifications starting from High School to the highest level and work experience. Deposit the one-time non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 590/- through the ICSIL website before applying. Submit your online application during the active window between 15/10/2026 (5:00 PM) and 18/10/2026 (5:00 PM).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If the number of eligible applicants disproportionately exceeds the number of positions, shortlisting for the interview may be conducted based on rational criteria. Shortlisting involves the scrutiny of documents regarding age, qualification, and experience, followed by an interaction or interview with the department. Candidates must produce original documents for verification on the date of the interview.

faq.question: Q1. Is this a permanent job or on contract?
faq.answer: The engagement is purely on a contractual and outsourced basis for a fixed period or till the expiry of the contract or till regular incumbents join posts, and does not guarantee regular appointment.

faq.question: Q2. How are candidates shortlisted for the position?
faq.answer: Shortlisting of applicants is based on document scrutiny of age, qualification, and experience, followed by an interaction or interview with the department.

faq.question: Q3. Which documents must be brought to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring original documents in respect of date of birth, qualification, and experience, along with one set of photocopies of all relevant documents and two photographs.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for ICSIL Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must deposit a one-time non-refundable registration fee of Rs. 590/- through the ICSIL website before applying.
